calculator_engine: function foreclosure(P,rate,tenureYrs,monthsElapsed,fcCharge){const r=rate/100/12;const n=tenureYrs*12;const emi=P*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);let outstanding=P;for(let i=0;i<monthsElapsed;i++){outstanding=outstanding*(1+r)-emi;}const charge=outstanding*fcCharge/100;const remaining=n-monthsElapsed;const interestSaved=emi*remaining-outstanding;return{outstanding,charge,total:outstanding+charge,interestSaved};}
